assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production RPG UI sprite atlas, not a screenshot. Make ONE square 2048x2048 transparent PNG atlas with a strict 2 by 2 equal-cell grid. Each cell is 1024x1024; center a circular painted clock medallion of diameter 880 pixels at each cell center, with generous fully TRANSPARENT padding around it. All four medallions have exactly the same diameter, camera, circular silhouette and narrow hand-carved oak and antique gold leaf frame with tiny botanical engravings. Beautiful artisanal gouache and watercolor drawings with delicate ink outlines, a charming anime storybook craft feeling, tactile paper grain, crisp silhouettes readable when small. The INNER round painting depicts the same tiny hill, winding path, pine trees and distant windmill under four distinct times: TOP LEFT rosy dawn with golden sunrise and pink wispy clouds; TOP RIGHT clear blue daylight with a beautiful radiant golden sun and white clouds; BOTTOM LEFT lavender and burnt peach sunset, glowing sun resting on the hill horizon; BOTTOM RIGHT deep indigo midnight, a luminous hand-drawn ivory crescent moon and many delicate gold stars, distant cozy window lights. Draw rich inviting illustrations, not simple geometric icons or photorealism. No hands, numbers, text, labels, interface, watermarks, gutters, grid lines or extra ornaments outside the four identical circular medallions. True transparency outside every circle. Exact 2x2 equal cell arrangement for runtime cropping; no clipped circle edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single finished Wind Slash ability icon for a handcrafted fantasy RPG HUD. A square 1024x1024 illustration with a deep desaturated forest teal painted background. At center, one elegant ivory crescent of rushing wind sweeps diagonally from bottom left to upper right around a short silver sword with a warm leather hilt, scattering a few pale turquoise leaf-shaped strokes and two tiny gold sparks. Strong simple silhouette, expressive brushwork, luminous edges and a beautiful hand-painted gouache texture with delicate ink contours. Souls-inspired equipment icon clarity with a gentle whimsical anime storybook feeling. Muted antique gold, ivory and blue-green, readable at 64 pixels. Fill the square; no border, UI frame, letters, numbers, watermark, humans or animals. This is one standalone skill illustration, not a contact sheet.
